title: CIA 90-day summary
description: The last 90 UTC days of CIA results, one letter and one set of counts per day, for the page's 90-day view. Stored at data/v1/cia/summary.json. A view derived from the day files: counts[i] is the number of measured slots of day i at each level, and days[i] follows from counts[i] by the day rule of the CIA contract.

firstRun.description: The slot of the first run ever recorded. Days before it have no data because the record had not started, not because the auditor missed them.

from.description: First day of the window: to minus 89 days.

to.description: Last day of the window: the day of the latest run.

p95Ms.description: Per day, oldest first: the 95th percentile of the service's /healthz latency that day, copied from latency.p95Ms of that day's file; null when the day has no file or no samples. Optional.

uptime.description: Availability over the window: slots at ok or warn, and slots at ok, warn or fail. The page shows up / measured.

regions.description: Per witness, oldest day first: the day letter of its availability (rule of the availability series), uptime over the window, and the day's p50Ms and p95Ms copied from regions.<id>.latency of the day file (null without samples). Optional.

counts.description: Per day, oldest first: [ok, warn, fail, none] measured slots.
